name: Closure of accounts and withdrawal of savings before travel
description: Customer empties accounts, cancels commitments or sells possessions in a short interval without clear purpose.
fp: May have innocent explanations; assess in context of customer profile and other indicators.

sources.text: FATF, Financing of the Terrorist Organisation Islamic State in Iraq and the Levant (ISIL) (2015)
UN Security Council Resolution 2178 (2014) on foreign terrorist fighters

links.name: Closure of accounts and withdrawal of savings before travel
links.ctx: Customer empties accounts, cancels commitments or sells possessions in a short interval without clear purpose.
links.fp: Emigration, study abroad and relocation are common legitimate reasons.
